# Third-party files of the page

Copied unchanged from their packages (or bundled from them); nothing is fetched at run time.

| File | Package | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `preact-htm.js` | `htm@3.1.1` (`preact/standalone.module.js`: Preact 10 with its hooks and htm) | Apache-2.0 (htm, `htm-LICENSE.txt`), MIT (Preact) |
| `editor.js` | CodeMirror 6 (`@codemirror/*`, `@lezer/*`) bundled with esbuild from `../../editor/index.js` (`../../editor/build.sh`) | MIT |
| `../fonts/InterVariable.woff2` | Inter 4.1 (rsms/inter) | SIL Open Font Licence 1.1 (`../fonts/Inter-LICENSE.txt`) |

The icons (`../js/symbols.js`) are Google's Material Symbols Rounded (Apache-2.0), made by
`tools/symbols.py`.
